question: The downstream speed is 125 km/hr and the upstream speed is 25 km/hr. It takes a total of 25 hours to go to a place and come back. What is the total distance (in km) travelled by boat?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance travelled = Average speed × Total time

Average speed for a round trip = (2 × Sd × Sᵤ) ÷ (Sd + Sᵤ)

Average speed = (2 × 125 × 25) ÷ (125 + 25) = 6250 ÷ 150 = 125/3 km/hr

Total distance = (125/3) × 25 = 3125/3 km = 1041²/₃ km.

**∴ The correct answer is 1041²/₃ km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Downstream speed (Sd) = 125 km/hr

Upstream speed (Sᵤ) = 25 km/hr

Total time taken (T) = 25 hours
